Those intrepid invertebrates return with a vengeance in the much-loved Worms Armageddon. Its a whole new can of worms!  Dis aint no fishing game. The ultimate test of strategy pits worm vs. worm throughout 54 different landscapes! Ignite 14 special weapons:      Deadly Fire Punch     Bouncy Banana Bombs     Super Sheep  Devise wickedly ingenious strategies so that your army of worms can wipe THEIR enemy of worms right off the planet!  Over-the-top action and endless supply of multiplayer modes make Worms Armageddon the perfect strategy game.

Tænding 14 specialvåben: Deadly Fire Punch Bouncy Banana Bomber Super Sheep Devise ondskabsfuldt geniale strategier, så din hær af orme kan tørre deres fjende af orme lige fra planeten! Over- the- top handling og endeløs forsyning af multiplayer tilstande gør Worms Armageddon den perfekte strategi spil.
